caseName: Boyd v. Pennsylvania State Board of Osteopathic Examiners
caseNameFull: Boyd v. Pennsylvania State Board of Osteopathic Examiners

opinions.text: Pa. Commw. Ct. Application for stay of suspension of license to practice pending timely filing and disposition of a petition for writ of certiorari, presented to Mr. Justice Brennan, and by him referred to the Court, denied.
